headline: Lawro's Predictions: GW6
deck: Lawro goes against test3 and backs test2, the closer of the two ties this week.
body: First column here, so nothing to own yet. Twenty-two years of scores on the BBC, and now here I am. The weather's grey and so am I.

ties.line: These two are cut from the same cloth. Both won one, lost one, and neither has settled into anything. This is a close one, and test3 are the favourites. I'm going against them. Why? test2 play the better football, plain and simple. Isak up top faces Manchester City, one of the three toughest defences going, so no picnic for him. He'll manage. Good forwards always do.

123 sit top, and they look the part. Haaland's away at Liverpool, one of the hardest this round for a forward, so don't expect him to enjoy it. Nobody does. Mbeumo's home to Tottenham for test4, and he'll fancy it. But Foden's suspended, and a worse man takes his place. That's how it goes. 123 have too much, though a quiet Haaland still beats most on a bad day.
